name: Cube CLI
description: Remote control for the CubeSandbox control plane: sandbox lifecycle, ports and files.
whenToUse: Create, list, inspect, pause, resume, snapshot, clone or delete a CubeSandbox, or debug control-plane connectivity.

items.name: guide
items.description: Cube CLI 完整使用手册与沙箱控制面工作流指引

secretBindings.label: CubeSandbox API Key
secretBindings.hint: CubeSandbox 控制面 API 访问密钥

tools.name: cube_version
tools.description: Show Cube CLI version and platform; returns { stdout, stderr, exitCode }.

tools.name: cube_health
tools.description: Check CubeSandbox control-plane health; returns { stdout, stderr, exitCode }.

tools.name: cube_run
tools.description: Run any Cube CLI subcommand (new, ls, rm, exec, code, info, ports...); returns { stdout, stderr, exitCode }.

cmd.description: Subcommand name, e.g. new, ls, rm, exec, code, info.

args.description: Arguments for the subcommand, e.g. ["--need=code"] or ["sid", "uname -a"].

tools.name: cube_submit
tools.description: Submit a long-running task asynchronously and return immediately; returns { taskId, cmd, status, message }.

tools.name: cube_log
tools.description: Read logs of a task submitted by cube_submit; returns { taskId, status, completed, exitCode, logs, nextOffset, totalLines }.

offset.description: Line index to start reading from; defaults to the beginning.

tools.name: cube_kill
tools.description: Terminate a running background task; returns { taskId, killed }.
